title: Single-stage joint diffusion of sky images and clear-sky index for ultra-short-term irradiance forecasting: what the frame-to-irradiance stage discards
abstract: arXiv:2610.21795v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sky-image irradiance forecasting is dominated by a two-stage design: a video-prediction model forecasts future sky frames, and a separately trained regressor maps those frames to irradiance. We propose a single-stage alternative that co-denoises the future sky-image and clear-sky-index sequences in one diffusion process, with an irradiance head that reads a denoised preview of the future sky rather than the noised diffusion state. The forecaster needs no regression stage and runs from sky images and deterministic covariates alone, with no measured irradiance at its input --- the situation at a site with a camera but no pyranometer. On 2023 SIRTA data the model reaches a pooled RMSE of $104.1$~W\,m$^{-2}$ and a skill score of $+0.34$ on the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) against smart persistence, higher than any of twelve baseline configurations, and retains that skill when retrained on 2021--2022. translated_title: 天空图像与晴空指数的单阶段联合扩散用于超短期辐照度预测：帧到辐照度阶段所丢弃的信息
translated_abstract: 天空图像辐照度预测目前以两阶段设计为主：由视频预测模型预测未来的天空图像帧，再由一个单独训练的回归器将这些帧映射为辐照度。我们提出一种单阶段替代方案，在同一个扩散过程中对未来的天空图像序列和晴空指数序列进行联合去噪，其中辐照度头读取的是未来天空的去噪预览，而非带噪声的扩散状态。该预测器不需要回归阶段，仅依靠天空图像和确定性协变量运行，输入中不含任何实测辐照度——这正是有相机但没有总辐射表的站点所面临的实际情形。在2023年SIRTA数据上，该模型达到了104.1 W m⁻²的汇总RMSE，以连续排序概率得分（CRPS）衡量的相对智能持续性模型的技巧得分为+0.34，高于全部十二个基线配置，并且在2021-2022年数据上重新训练后仍能保持该技巧水平。在该模型自身生成的……
tldr: 该论文提出一种在单一扩散过程中联合去噪未来天空图像与晴空指数的单阶段辐照度预测模型，省去了传统两阶段设计中的独立回归器且无需实测辐照度输入，在仅有相机的站点上实现了超越十二个基线配置的超短期辐照度预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a single-stage diffusion model that jointly denoises future sky images and clear-sky index sequences, eliminating the separate frame-to-irradiance regression stage and requiring no measured irradiance input, thereby achieving ultra-short-term irradiance forecasting performance that outperforms twelve baseline configurations even at sites equipped with only a camera.
